name: Curve
spec: yellow diamond with a black curved arrow bending right
meaning: The road curves ahead; slow down and stay in your lane.

snippets.back: People walking or bicycling near the road, animals, railroad crossings, intersections, bridges, curves and steep descents call for extra caution.
With total hydroplaning there is no friction to brake, speed up or turn, so wind or a slight curve can cause an uncontrollable skid.
The guide lists an obstructed view near a steep hill, sharp curve, or narrow-valley exit among situations for a horn warning.
An orange sign with black letters gives a recommended safe speed for a curve, a grade or another special condition, so slow down until you are sure you can get through safely.
Slow before a curve or any area where the view ahead is restricted.
Narrow hilly or wooded roads hide blind pockets where another car may be only feet away before you see it, so use extra caution and tap the horn on dangerous curves.
Slow before a curve rather than relying on braking after entering it.
Turn, curve and winding road signs warn drivers of bends in the roadway ahead.

result.summary: Meaning supported by bend-ahead warning plus slow-before-curve advice; no snippet describes yellow diamond/black arrow shape.
